plan.title: Add Document Symbol Provider for plan.xml files to enable Outline view navigation
plan.overview: Implement a DocumentSymbolProvider for plan.xml files that enables VSCode's Outline panel, breadcrumb navigation, and Ctrl+Shift+O quick symbol search. The implementation follows the Capability/Computer separation pattern: plan-parser.computer.ts handles pure XML parsing with line position tracking, plan-symbol.capability.ts wraps the VSCode DocumentSymbolProvider API with EventEmitter for refresh, and tasks.orchestrator.ts coordinates wiring with the existing file watcher.

approach.rationale:
Following three established patterns from the codebase:
1. **Capability/Computer Separation**: Pure parsing logic in plan-parser.computer.ts (no VSCode imports), DocumentSymbolProvider API wrapping in plan-symbol.capability.ts. Reference: task-parser.computer.ts:1-61 and codelens.capability.ts:18-66
2. **Factory-DI Pattern**: Both computer and capability use factory functions with typed dependencies. The capability receives parser functions as deps for testability. Reference: codelens.capability.ts:18-66
3. **EventEmitter Refresh**: Use EventEmitter for onDidChangeDocumentSymbols event, returning a refresh callback that the orchestrator wires to the existing file watcher. Reference: codelens.capability.ts:21-22, 58-60
Key architectural decisions: - Line position tracking via hybrid approach: parse XML structure with fast-xml-parser, then line-scan the raw text to map element start positions (fast-xml-parser doesn't expose line numbers in parsed output) - Hierarchical symbols: plan root > sections (tasks, testing, edge-cases, pitfalls, notes) > individual items within sections - Status indicators: Unicode prefix (checkmark U+2713 for completed, circle U+25CB for pending) - Symbol kinds mapped semantically: Class for plan root, Module for sections, Method for tasks - Label truncation at 60 characters to keep Outline readable

Return empty symbol array, Outline shows nothing
Show plan root and any other sections present
File watcher triggers refresh callback, symbols update

pitfalls.pitfall: Parser doesn't expose line numbers - use hybrid line-scan approach: parse for structure, regex scan for positions
VSCode uses 0-based line numbers, ensure consistent indexing throughout
endLine must be within document bounds - clamp to document.lineCount - 1
DocumentSymbolProvider doesn't have native onDidChangeDocumentSymbols - the refresh callback fires EventEmitter but VSCode re-queries automatically on document change
Use **/.kanban/tasks/*/plan.xml not **/plan.xml to avoid matching non-kanban files
